name: portside
description: A Kubernetes-inspired container orchestrator built in TypeScript with gRPC-based control plane, resource-aware scheduling, rolling deployments, and chaos-tested resilience.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:cp && npm run build:agent && npm run build:proxy && npm run build:cli && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.test:unit: cd tests && npx vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:property: cd tests && npx vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts property/
